segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Mortar adjustment decision: 'Two shorts in a row, statistically we were about due to get one on target...' through '...random scatter that would sort itself out on its own.'
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant expects the next independent round to succeed because the prior two rounds missed.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Grid discrepancy decision: 'I went with Grid A...' through '...makes it feel more solid, even if I can't point to a real reason the information itself was better.'
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant preferentially weights the own-unit channel despite similar report quality.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: CAS decision: 'I cleared it hot with the tighter margin...' through '...The history with them is what made the tighter margin feel acceptable.'
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Recent successful strikes with the squadron reduce perceived risk despite tighter margins and communication dropouts.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Artillery decision: 'I approved it off the single cue...' through '...I was focused on the cue itself, not really running the sector's track record against it.'
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant acts on one cue while disregarding the quiet sector history and known sensor false-positive history.
